text: I'm using it right now to write this review. I've been using it recently for pretty much all of my work stuff, and it's been a real lifesaver in terms of saving time. It's great also that it understands other languages, especially relatively rare ones. This is very useful when I don't want to type in other languages where I'm much slower. The fact that it reformats my thoughts correctly, so that there are no vague misunderstandings, is really useful.
